rawContent: I mean, if you're a man who secretly deep down thinks sexual assault is NBD and all these #MeToo harpies should just shut up, you're going to feel a little uncomfortable condemning DJT for expressing that same opinion.
@jackwilliambell Absolutely. I think a lot of #MeToo abuses are coming from that dynamic.

I mean, I know pretending to be stupid about something really fricking obvious is kind of the conservative M.O. these days, but sheesh. It's like she hasn't read a single first hand account of abuse and is arguing with a  fake #MeToo that she just made up.

And DJT takes the concept of forcing somebody to submit to a medical procedure and turns it into a rape joke. "Haha, we'd better be gentle with her, it's the #MeToo generation, but we're gonna force her to do this thing."
